global_constraints.CRITICAL_RULE: Labels are IMMUTABLE ground truth. The algorithm must be tuned to match the labels, NEVER the other way around.
forbidden_actions: Changing any keyframe values in labels
Adjusting labels to match algorithm output
global_constraints.frame_tolerance: ±8 frames from labeled values for all keyframes
global_constraints.failure_response: If algorithm cannot match labels within tolerance, document the gap in algorithm-learnings.md and try a different algorithmic approach. NEVER modify labels.

analysis_approach: Read poses.json around labeled keyframe (±10 frames)
Examine ALL available pose landmarks at labeled frame vs surrounding frames
Identify what makes the labeled frame distinct from surrounding frames

keyframe_specific_hints.legs_start_bending: Look for knee angle decrease beginning, hip drop start
keyframe_specific_hints.ball_low_point: Find lowest wrist Y position during dip phase
keyframe_specific_hints.legs_start_extending: Detect knee angle starting to increase
keyframe_specific_hints.ball_starts_upward: Detect wrist Y velocity turning negative (upward)
keyframe_specific_hints.set_point: Ball at highest position before release motion begins
keyframe_specific_hints.release: Maximum wrist flexion (snap), ball leaves hand
keyframe_specific_hints.feet_leave_ground: Ankle Y position drops below threshold (jump)
keyframe_specific_hints.feet_land: Ankle Y returns to ground level

iteration_process: 1. Run test, note which keyframes fail and by how many frames
2. Load poses.json for failing video, examine frames around labeled keyframe
3. Hypothesize what signal would correctly identify the labeled frame
5. If regression in other videos, refine approach to work for all
algorithm_tuning_guidance.success_criteria: Algorithm detects all 10 keyframes within ±8 of labels using consistent logic across all videos

context.data_model: Knee angle calculated from: hip, knee, ankle landmarks. Ball position approximated by wrist Y. MediaPipe landmark indices: LEFT_HIP=23, RIGHT_HIP=24, LEFT_KNEE=25, RIGHT_KNEE=26, LEFT_ANKLE=27, RIGHT_ANKLE=28, LEFT_WRIST=15, RIGHT_WRIST=16

context.data_model: Velocity calculated as: (value[frame] - value[frame-1]) / (1/fps). Positive knee angle velocity = extending. Negative wrist Y velocity = rising (since Y=0 is top).
context.technical_notes: Look for sustained direction change, not single-frame spikes. Consider requiring 2-3 consecutive frames of positive velocity to confirm. The ball_starts_upward detection can reuse wrist tracking from existing shot detector.

set_point occurs before release, release occurs after set_point
Use elbow angle and wrist angle to distinguish set_point from release

edge_cases: Quick release with minimal pause at set point: set_point and release may be close

context.data_model: Set point identified by: wrist at local high point, elbow still bent. Release identified by: wrist moving forward/down, elbow extending, wrist flexion at maximum. Elbow angle from shoulder-elbow-wrist vectors.
context.technical_notes: The set_point is the 'cocking' position where the ball is held at highest point before the forward/upward release motion. The release is when the wrist snaps (maximum wrist flexion angle) which is when the ball leaves the hand.
